Legal

Using this website.

Last updated: 18 September 2026

Website and professional information

dot.wave is a multidisciplinary consulting collective. Website content introduces its approach and members’ experience. It is general information, not a binding offer or individualized professional advice.

Engagements and procurement

Each project requires a separately agreed proposal and contract. Scope, responsibilities, fees, timetable and the Indonesian contracting entity are identified during that process. The dot.wave brand name is not a substitute for the legal entity identified in the contract.

Work, attribution and intellectual property

Selected work identifies members’ prior experience; it does not imply that dot.wave commissioned or contracted those projects. Project and client names, imagery and trademarks belong to their respective owners. Member contributions are described separately from overall project outcomes. Do not reproduce third-party work without permission from the relevant rights holder.

External links

Linked websites are operated independently and have their own terms and privacy practices. References to organizations document experience and do not imply endorsement of dot.wave.
